comment: Options menu, bind keys, key first: 'K', bound to runnorth, to apply (cmd.c handler_rebind_keys_add(), Strcat() at line 2379). Recorded on macOS by .github/workflows/macos-recorder.yml, not on Linux: cmd.c handler_rebind_keys_add() appends with Strcat() to the uninitialized cmdstr (line 2356). On the judge's macOS build that buffer does not start with a zero byte, so bind_key() matches no command and line 2402 prints "Key binding failed?!"; a Linux recorder happens to bind the key (docs/testing.md, "The key-binding difference").
